title: OpenDEA Assessment Item
description: The instrument-specific binding of a reusable Question to the model context (CR-AM-05A §25). Contextual properties live here — not on the global Question definition — so the same Question can be used differently in different instruments (§24, §19). If Question↔Criterion cardinality ever needs constraining, it is constrained here, preserving question reuse (§19).

question.description: The versioned Question this item administers (§16, §33: the effective question version is part of result lineage).

dimension.description: The Dimension context for this item within the instrument (§24).

criterion.description: The Criterion this item contributes evidence to (§13, §18).

measure.description: The Measure the resulting Observation feeds (§13, §21).

sequence.description: Ordering within the instrument/section; overrides the Question's default sequence hint (§25).

required.description: Whether a response is mandatory in this instrument context; overrides the Question's default (§25).

applicability.description: Instrument-specific applicability condition (e.g. 'only when automated decisioning is in scope').
